title: Colonel Coleman's B-25 UFO encounter over Alabama

tellings.quote: that led me to to Colonel William Coleman who had that dramatic encounter uh with UFO and B-55 over Alabama,

plain: In the 1950s, an Air Force officer named Colonel William Coleman is said to have had a dramatic run-in with a UFO while flying a B-25 bomber over Alabama. The documentary maker James Fox mentions it in passing as a case that led him to track Coleman down, calling the plane a "B-55" as he speaks. It would mean a senior military flyer met something unexplained in the air.
